Date : May 20, 2027
Meeting of the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) – Rescheduled

As announced in the Reserve Bank’s Press Release: 2026-2027/9999 dated March 24, 2027 , the next meeting of the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) during the financial year 2027-28 was scheduled during June 2, 3 and 4, 2027. With June 2, 2027 being declared a public holiday, the MPC meeting has been rescheduled to June 3 – 5, 2027. This announcement is made under Section 45ZI(4) of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.

Press Release: 2027-2028/321
